title: Say what you are looking for
name: I am looking for…
summary: An easy way to get directions or locate an item.
rule: Suchen takes a direct object (accusative). For masculine nouns, der becomes den.
examples: I am looking for the train station.
I am looking for the pharmacy.
I am looking for an ATM.
avoid: Ich suche der Bahnhof is incorrect. Say den Bahnhof.
note: You can add Entschuldigung at the beginning to get attention.
